description: 通用 MCP 框架：引用后把方法标成 [McpServerTool]，一行 McpServer.StartAsync 即可把任意 .NET 程序（Console / Web / WinForms / WPF）开放为 MCP 工具，供 Agent 控制。基于官方 ModelContextProtocol SDK，支持 Stdio、Streamable HTTP 与遗留 SSE。
Azure Blob Storage provider on backend
Amazon S3 and S3 compatible (MinIO, Ceph...) storage provider on backend
Fair, repeatable and verifiable random lotteries (draws without replacement). A .NET binding of libsortition; it loads the native library.
Custom window chrome for Photino.Blazor: title bar, resize borders, rounded corners and native move/resize on Windows, Linux (X11/Wayland) and macOS.

Blazor component library with light/dark theming: buttons, cards, forms, dialogs, menus, tabs, tables, snackbars and more. No JavaScript, and the stylesheet is inlined, so it also runs on hosts such as Photino.
